purpose: Groups related content and actions into a visually distinct surface. Used to present a single subject — such as a product, article, or profile — with consistent padding and a 1px border. Corners are square and there is no shadow.

props.name: variant
props.description: default is a raised surface with a border; interactive is clickable; flat sits on a sunken surface. Defaults to default

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the card interactive when provided — sets role='button' and tabIndex=0

props.name: href
props.description: Renders the card as a link when provided

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for interactive cards without a visible heading

props.name: as
props.description: Polymorphic root element. Defaults to div

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks an interactive card as the current selection. Sets aria-pressed (button) or aria-current (link)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents interaction on an interactive card and applies disabled styling. Sets aria-disabled

whenToUse: To group a single subject's content — image, title, description and actions — into one container
To display a list of similar items (product grid, article feed) with consistent visual treatment
As a container for a summary or preview with a link to a detail page
whenNotToUse: As a full-page layout container — use page-level spacing tokens directly
For modal or overlay content — use Modal instead
To nest another Card inside — do not nest cards
antiPatterns: Nesting a Card inside another Card
Using Card as an interactive element without setting role and keyboard handling
Hardcoding padding, adding a border-radius or adding a box-shadow — use the padding prop; cards are square and flat
a11yNotes: Interactive cards (onClick or href) must be reachable by keyboard with Tab
Interactive cards must have a visible focus ring using color-interactive-focus-ring
Provide aria-label when the card has no visible heading or the heading alone is ambiguous
Do not place interactive elements inside a card that is itself interactive — this creates nested interactive regions
